name: Amos Tull
role: speculator who built the shipping pens
want: bring the railroad and the cattle trade to Salt Lick and be rich by the fall
secret: The letter of promise he shows investors is his own forgery, and the men he owes in Leavenworth give him until September.
voice: A salesman's warmth, a speech for every occasion.
description: The town company's president and promoter, who borrowed to build the hotel, the pens and his own reputation.
appearance: A good suit going shiny, a gold watch chain, a smile that stops at his eyes.
